killedBy: the screen baseline: how far a box may move between platforms (issue #861) reports the very next pixel, so the tolerance is a band and not a shrug
why: Loosens the band that decides what this gate can still see. Two pixels is the measured residue of cross-platform rasterisation -- 70 values at 1px and 36 at 2px across two full runs, nothing between 3px and 54px once hinting was disabled -- so 3px starts absorbing differences that are not artefacts. A tolerance nobody can fail is the quiet way a regression gate stops being one, and the number drifts upward one pixel at a time unless the boundary itself is asserted.
